name: heat_pump_cycle_r22_30kw
title: R22 heat pump cycle delivering 30 kW
summary: R22 heat pump between 8 °C (evaporator) and 60 °C (condenser) with 10 K subcooling, no superheat and a compressor of 0.80 isentropic efficiency, fed by 10 °C groundwater (evaporator effectiveness 1); computes the COP, the refrigerant flow rate and the groundwater flow rate for 30 kW of heating.

authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise)

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/refrigeration2.EES, EES 7.210)
verification.notes: All live model variables agree within 0.27 % (largest: evaporator-inlet quality x_4; flow rate and specific heating effect 0.13 %; COP 0.05 %; EES 7.210 vs CoolProp R22 properties). The stored P[1..3]/h[1..4] are stale (diagram block commented out at last EES run), ignored; stray scalar h and commented-out eta_m define no variable. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/refrigeration2.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
